label: prop:q-beta-cos-resummation
title: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ cos-resummation: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{A,\cos} = \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^A \cdot \cos((z-1)h/2)$ tightens the CODATA residual by $5.49\times$ via classical-cos eigenphase symmetrization (conditional on the transfer-matrix eigenphase identification)
html:
\mathfrak{Q}_\beta cos-resummation theorem (conditional on \beta-decay transfer matrix). The single-wrap Form A closed-form prediction \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^A admits a tighter symbolic refinement. We obtain this refinement by replacing the linear bridge correction (z-1)h/2 with the classical cosine of half-argument:

  \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^{A,\mathrm{cos}}
  \;:=\;
  \mathfrak{Q}_\beta^A \cdot \cos\!\bigl(\tfrac{(z-1)\,h}{2}\bigr),
  \qquad
  z = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt q + 1/\sqrt q},
  \quad
  h = q - q^{-1}.

This refinement tightens the CODATA residual from +1677.5 ppm to +305.7 ppm.

The transfer-matrix M_\beta has spectrum \{e^{+i\alpha},\, e^{-i\alpha}\} on the 2-dimensional irreducible representation V_{(2,1)} of H_3(q). The eigenphase is \alpha = (z-1) h / 2 at the single-wrap order. The Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M symmetrizes the two eigenphases:

  \mathrm{tr}_M(M_\beta)
  \;=\;
  \cos\alpha
  \;=\;
  \cos\!\bigl(\tfrac{(z-1)\,h}{2}\bigr).

Two structural constraints enforce this form:

  1. Markov cyclicity. The trace is cyclic. It is invariant under the bar involution q \mapsto q^{-1}, which maps \alpha \mapsto -\alpha. The resummation must be even in \alpha. The minimal even-power resummation that matches the linear bridge at the perturbative level is the cosine.
  2. Classical decategorification. The mass observable lives in the classical limit, not in the q-deformed quantum group. The classical cosine is more accurate by \approx 7 ppm than the q-deformed cosine.

The resummation lives in the real-q (archimedean) regime of the framework's dilogarithm context-sorting, fixed once by the \Phi_q/AJ machinery identification.
